opportunities.title: Early Career Fellowship Grants, 2026-27
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early career historians within five years of submitting their corrected doctoral thesis in a historical subject to a UK institution, normally resident in the UK, not in full-time permanent academic employment, and current members of the Royal Historical Society. Current doctoral students not eligible.
opportunities.summary: Grants of up to £2,000 (maximum) for discrete research projects lasting no more than six months, supporting career-building research or activities post-PhD to enable production of a discrete scholarly outcome (e.g. an article or book proposal).

opportunities.title: Martin Lynn Scholarship in African History, 2026-27
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Members of the Royal Historical Society currently studying for a PhD, undertaking research in African history. Applications from previous awardees not eligible.
opportunities.summary: Annual award of £1,500 to support the doctoral research of a postgraduate researcher in African history.

opportunities.title: Open Research Support Grants, 2026-27
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Members of the Royal Historical Society who are not postgraduate students or early career researchers (i.e. more than 5 years on from PhD completion).
opportunities.summary: Awards of either £500 or £1,000 to support historians without access to research funding to visit archives and historical sites, conduct interviews, and travel to academic conferences. Priority given to those with no or insufficient funding streams.

opportunities.title: Postgraduate Research Support Grants, 2026
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Current Postgraduate Members of the Royal Historical Society studying for a Master's degree or PhD in History. Not open to those who have completed their doctorate.
opportunities.summary: Grants of £500 or £1,000 for postgraduate historians to undertake historical research, including visiting archives or historic sites and conducting interviews (not conference attendance).

opportunities.title: Early Career Research Support Grants, 2026
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Current members of the Royal Historical Society within five years of submitting their corrected doctoral thesis in a historical subject. Not open to postgraduate students or those more than five years beyond PhD completion.
opportunities.summary: Grants of £500 or £1,000 to enable early career historians to undertake research activities essential to their projects, such as visiting archives or historic sites and conducting interviews (not conference attendance).

opportunities.title: David Berry Fellowship in the History of Scotland and the Scottish People
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Current members of the Royal Historical Society at all career stages from PhD research and beyond, in any of the Society's membership categories.
opportunities.summary: Annual award of up to £2,500 to undertake research on the history of Scotland and/or the Scottish people within the United Kingdom or worldwide. 2026 applications closed 6 March 2026; next call expected to open in late 2026.

opportunities.title: RHS Workshop Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Current Fellows or Members of the Royal Historical Society.
opportunities.summary: Grants of £1,000 to enable historians to come together for a day event to pursue projects of shared interest, including discussion of research topics, developing teaching practices, grant planning and networking. 2026 applications closed 23 January 2026; next call expected from late 2026 for awards in Spring 2027.
